notes: R = reference coding genes after evaluation-mode, biotype, transcript-selection and scope filtering (comparator total_reference_genes). Q = query (predicted) genes in scope (total_consensus_genes; 'consensus' means query in comparator keys). Genes without a comparable CDS stay in R and Q.

Every metric is for one reference, one scope, one transcript policy and one prediction run (including its comparator options, e.g. stop-codon harmonisation). Values from different references, scopes, policies or query coordinates are never pooled.

Source types: comparator = comparison_summary.json (authoritative); comparator_per_gene = counted from comparison_details.tsv of the same run; reference_models = needs per-gene CDS segment counts computed with the comparator's parser/selection on the reference; independent = independent analysis, used only after per-gene agreement with the comparator; historical = an earlier dashboard derivation kept for comparison with older reports, never used in place of a comparator value; paper_analogous = supporting context, not a reproduction of the Tiberius benchmark.

Status: not_available = a required input is absent or the result predates the field; undefined = the comparator reports the value as undefined (denominator 0); not_applicable = the metric does not apply (stop-codon counts of an original-coordinate run); inconsistent = two outputs of the same comparator result disagree (shown with the reason, never corrected). None of these is zero.

Query coordinates: original = the prediction file as written. stop_harmonised = the comparator's --add-stop-codon evaluated annotation, in which a terminal CDS segment is extended by 3 bp only where the frame is established from the sequence and the next codon is an in-frame stop. Stop-harmonised results are supplementary; they align a CDS convention and do not establish ORF validity.

Sequence scopes: the whole compared scope shows the comparator's own values. A supplementary scope (source 'scope_filter') removes reference and predicted genes on other sequences before every value: per-gene outcomes and one-to-one exact pairs on the scope's sequences, over the scoped R and Q (the maximum matching decomposes by sequence). Each build first reproduces the whole-scope comparator values from the same per-gene data; a disagreement marks the scoped values inconsistent.

Exploratory splice-site plots (views with one reference transcript per gene): a reference CDS donor/acceptor is supported when any evaluated predicted transcript has a CDS intron with the same donor/acceptor on the same sequence and strand; a reference intron is recovered when the identical CDS intron exists. Rates are over sites/introns of reference genes whose locus was recovered (same-strand CDS overlap); sites of other genes are counted separately as missing-locus sites. Positions are oriented in the direction of transcription (0 = coding start, 1 = coding end). Intron-length bins are fixed and identical for every run. Associations only.

groups.label: CDS headline metrics
groups.description: CDS-focused: predictors may not model UTRs.

groups.label: UTR-inclusive agreement (not for ranking CDS-only predictors)
Historical estimates (comparison with older reports only)

metrics.label: Reference loci recovered (same-strand CDS overlap)
metrics.numerator: reference genes with a same-strand query locus partner whose transcripts share at least one CDS base (unrounded cds_overlap > 0)
source_fields: cross-checked against comparison_details.tsv cds_overlap > 0 (older results: per-gene count only)
metrics.definition: Locus found with real coding overlap.
limitations: Differs from gene-span locus detection, which pairs genes whose spans overlap even without shared exons or CDS.

metrics.label: Coordinate-exact CDS (reference side)
metrics.numerator: reference genes with an evaluated isoform whose CDS intervals (start, every splice site, stop) equal a query transcript's
metrics.definition: Strictest coding-accuracy measure.
limitations: Under policy A any eligible isoform may match, so the value is more lenient than a single-representative policy (B, C).
Not the historical Exact_Match class, which tolerates different start/stop coordinates.
Requires identical stop-codon convention in reference and query (CDS including vs excluding the stop codon).
Counts reference genes, so it can exceed the one-to-one TP when two reference genes share an exact query partner (or the reverse).

metrics.label: Coordinate-exact CDS (query side)
metrics.numerator: query genes whose best CDS pair is coordinate-identical to an evaluated reference isoform
metrics.definition: Fraction of predictions that are exactly right.
limitations: Predictions at loci outside the evaluated reference (pseudogenes, unannotated genes) count in Q.

metrics.label: One-to-one exact-CDS recall
metrics.numerator: TP = matched (reference gene, query gene) pairs in a maximum one-to-one matching of genes that share an identical CDS (same sequence, strand and every CDS interval)
metrics.definition: TP / R. Each reference and each query gene is used at most once.
limitations: Coordinate-exact: a stop codon included on one side and excluded on the other prevents a match (see query coordinates).
Results that predate the comparator's matching show not_available; the historical best-pair estimate is listed separately.

metrics.label: One-to-one exact-CDS precision
metrics.numerator: TP
metrics.definition: TP / Q.
limitations: Q includes predictions at loci outside the evaluated reference subset (pseudogenes, non-coding or unannotated loci).

metrics.label: One-to-one exact-CDS F1
metrics.numerator: 2 TP
metrics.definition: 2 TP / (R + Q), the harmonic mean of precision and recall.
limitations: Gene-level coordinate-exact F1; stricter than intron-chain (gffcompare-like) F1 used in publications.
Not a ranking of tools in general: one prediction run, one reference, one policy.

metrics.label: CDS intron chain recovered (best pair)
metrics.numerator: multi-segment reference genes whose comparator best CDS pair has an identical CDS intron chain
metrics.definition: Splice structure right, ends may differ.
limitations: Evaluated on the single best pair: a ≥ 0.8-overlap pair with a different chain outranks an identical-chain pair with lower overlap.
A multi-segment gene whose best pair uses a single-segment isoform counts as not recovered.

metrics.label: CDS intron chain recovered (any pair)
metrics.numerator: multi-segment reference genes with an identical CDS intron chain between ANY evaluated isoform and ANY query transcript
metrics.definition: Upper bound on chain recovery independent of pair ranking.
limitations: Available only when the independent analysis was run (or imported) and agrees with the comparator per gene.

metrics.label: Reference CDS introns recovered (unique set)
metrics.numerator: unique (seq, strand, start, end) CDS introns of evaluated reference transcripts also present in the query
metrics.definition: Splice-site-level recovery.
limitations: Set-based, not per gene: the denominator grows with the number of evaluated isoforms (policy A much larger than B/C).

metrics.label: Query CDS introns supported (unique set)
metrics.numerator: unique query CDS introns also present in the evaluated reference
metrics.denominator: unique query CDS introns in scope
metrics.definition: Splice-site precision.
limitations: Set-based.
Includes query introns at loci outside the evaluated reference subset (pseudogenes, non-coding or unevaluated genes), which count as unsupported.

metrics.label: Missed reference genes
metrics.numerator: reference genes with no same-strand partner and no opposite-strand feature overlap
metrics.definition: Comparator class Missed.
limitations: A gene with only gene-span contact is not Missed; see 'no CDS overlap'.

metrics.label: Reference genes without CDS overlap
metrics.numerator: R minus loci recovered by CDS overlap
metrics.definition: Coding-level miss (includes Missed, Strand_Mismatch and span-only detections).

metrics.label: Unmatched predictions (Novel)
metrics.numerator: query genes with no same-strand reference partner and no opposite-strand feature overlap
metrics.definition: Comparator class Novel; see Novel-context categories.
limitations: Relative to the evaluated reference: predictions on pseudogenes or unannotated loci are Novel.

metrics.label: Splits (reference genes with ≥ 2 query counterparts)
metrics.numerator: reference genes with ≥ 2 same-strand query counterparts sharing ≥ 10 % of the shorter CDS
metrics.definition: Over-segmentation.
limitations: Fixed 10 % shared-CDS threshold.

metrics.label: Merges (query genes with ≥ 2 reference counterparts)
metrics.numerator: query genes with ≥ 2 reference counterparts
metrics.definition: Under-segmentation.
limitations: Fixed 10 % shared-CDS threshold.

metrics.label: Reference genes with exactly one counterpart
metrics.numerator: reference genes with one query counterpart

metrics.label: Strand mismatch (reference)
metrics.numerator: reference genes whose only partners are opposite-strand with CDS (or exon) overlap
limitations: A gene with any same-strand partner is never Strand_Mismatch.

metrics.label: Strand mismatch (query)
metrics.numerator: query genes whose only partners are opposite-strand with feature overlap

metrics.label: Coordinate-exact CDS, multi-segment genes
metrics.numerator: coordinate-exact genes with an evaluated isoform of > 1 CDS segment
source_fields: reference models: max CDS segments per gene
limitations: Needs the prepared reference annotation; the count is checked against the comparator's multi_segment_cds_reference_genes.

metrics.label: Coordinate-exact CDS, single-segment genes
metrics.numerator: coordinate-exact genes whose evaluated isoforms all have one CDS segment
limitations: Needs the prepared reference annotation.

metrics.label: Partial CDS recovery
metrics.numerator: reference genes whose best CDS pair shares coding bases but is not coordinate-exact
metrics.definition: Sum of the three partial buckets below.

metrics.label: … same CDS intron chain, start/stop differs
metrics.numerator: partial genes with CDS class Exact_Match (historical structural match)
limitations: Mostly alternative start codons in the benchmark; check stop-codon conventions before interpreting stop-side differences.

metrics.label: … ≥ 0.8 reciprocal CDS overlap, different chain
metrics.numerator: partial genes with CDS class Structural_Mismatch

metrics.label: … < 0.8 reciprocal CDS overlap
metrics.numerator: partial genes with CDS class Partial_Match and CDS overlap > 0

metrics.label: Historical CDS Exact_Match (structural)
metrics.numerator: reference genes with CDS class Exact_Match: identical CDS intron chain and ≥ 0.8 reciprocal overlap
metrics.definition: Kept for compatibility.
limitations: NOT coordinate-exact: terminal coordinates may differ. Use coordinate-exact CDS for exactness.

metrics.label: Gene-span locus detection
metrics.numerator: reference genes classified Exact_Match, Structural_Mismatch or Partial_Match (same-strand gene-span overlap)
metrics.definition: Comparator locus pairing.
limitations: Gene spans can pair genes without shared exons or CDS; prefer same-strand CDS-overlap recovery.

metrics.label: Span-only detections (no exon overlap)
metrics.numerator: detected reference genes without exonic overlap

metrics.label: Span-detected without CDS overlap
metrics.numerator: detected reference genes whose best CDS pair shares no coding base

metrics.label: Matched predictions without CDS overlap
metrics.numerator: query genes with a same-strand partner but no CDS overlap

metrics.label: Exact pairs reusing a query gene
metrics.numerator: coordinate-exact reference genes whose query partner is also exact for another reference gene
metrics.definition: Per-gene best-pair rows only; the comparator's one-to-one matching resolves reuse exactly.

metrics.label: One-to-one exact-CDS pairs (TP)
metrics.numerator: matched pairs of the comparator's maximum bipartite matching (Kuhn's augmenting paths, deterministic tie order)
metrics.definition: Each gene used once; other maximum matchings with the same TP can exist inside components with several edges.
limitations: The per-gene coordinate-exact counts (cds_exact_ref, cds_exact_query) can exceed TP when one gene has exact partners in several genes.

metrics.label: Reference genes without a one-to-one exact pair
metrics.numerator: R − TP

metrics.label: Query genes without a one-to-one exact pair
metrics.numerator: Q − TP

metrics.label: Exact-CDS gene pairs (edges before matching)
metrics.numerator: (reference gene, query gene) pairs sharing at least one identical CDS
metrics.definition: Edges of the matching graph; TP ≤ this count.

metrics.label: Exact-CDS components with several edges
metrics.numerator: connected components of the exact-CDS gene graph with more than one edge
metrics.definition: Where tie resolution could choose a different (equally large) matching.

metrics.label: Novel: on reference pseudogene
metrics.numerator: Novel query genes overlapping (either strand, exons) a reference pseudogene removed by filtering
limitations: Uses the reference before biotype filtering.

metrics.label: Novel: on unevaluated coding reference
metrics.definition: e.g. coding genes removed by transcript-biotype filtering

metrics.label: Novel: opposite strand of evaluated gene (UTR/exon only)
Exon coordinate-exact (includes UTRs)
metrics.numerator: reference genes whose best exon pair has identical exon intervals
limitations: Near zero by construction for CDS-only predictors; not a ranking metric for them.

metrics.label: Historical Exact_Match (exon level, structural)
metrics.numerator: identical exon intron chain and ≥ 0.8 reciprocal exon overlap
limitations: Not coordinate-exact; includes UTRs; not a ranking metric for CDS-only predictors.

metrics.label: Reference coding genes (R)
metrics.numerator: R

metrics.label: Evaluated reference transcripts
metrics.numerator: transcripts after filtering and selection

metrics.label: Predicted genes in scope (Q)
metrics.numerator: Q

metrics.label: Predicted transcripts in scope
metrics.numerator: query transcripts after query selection

metrics.label: Historical best-pair exact TP (estimate)
metrics.numerator: min(unique reference genes, unique query genes) among per-gene best-pair coordinate-exact rows
metrics.definition: The earlier dashboard derivation (and the 2026-10-05 benchmark headline). Kept for comparison only.
limitations: Not a matching: it can over- or under-count when exact partners are shared or lie outside the per-gene best pair. Use exact_tp_one_to_one.

metrics.label: Historical best-pair exact recall (estimate)
metrics.numerator: historical TP
limitations: Superseded by exact_recall_one_to_one.

metrics.label: Historical best-pair exact precision (estimate)
metrics.numerator: historical TP
limitations: Superseded by exact_precision_one_to_one.

metrics.label: Historical best-pair exact F1 (estimate)
metrics.numerator: harmonic mean of the historical recall and precision
limitations: Superseded by exact_f1_one_to_one.

metrics.label: Query transcripts with CDS (audited)
metrics.numerator: query transcripts with CDS before transcript selection and regions
metrics.definition: Applies only to --add-stop-codon runs.

metrics.label: Frame established from sequence
metrics.numerator: transcripts passing every frame check (ATG start, length a multiple of 3, no internal stop, only ACGT, inside the sequence, genetic code known)
limitations: Phase is not used.

metrics.label: Terminal CDS extended by an adjacent stop
metrics.numerator: eligible transcripts whose next 3 bases are an in-frame stop of the genetic code, added to the terminal CDS segment
limitations: Split stops, extensions beyond explicit exons or the sequence end, and ambiguous bases are skipped, not repaired.

metrics.label: Unchanged (stop already included, or no adjacent stop)
metrics.numerator: eligible transcripts left as written

metrics.label: Skipped (reason recorded)
metrics.numerator: transcripts failing a frame check or whose extension is not allowed
metrics.definition: Compared with their original coordinates.

paper_analogous.label: Paper-analogous (supporting context)
paper_analogous.definition: Gene- and CDS-exon-level recall/precision/F1 computed independently with one transcript per gene on both sides, to set results beside the Tiberius paper.
limitations: Not a reproduction: different reference (Ensembl vs RefSeq), tool (not gffcompare), rules and model versions.
Mouse was a Tiberius training genome; mouse values are not comparable with the paper.
